name: @nuclescript/std
description: The NucleScript standard library, written in NucleScript: generic helpers that loop over the files a pool holds, with effect ceilings on the actions they run.

exports.name: clear
exports.description: Deletes every file a pool of any profile holds when the call runs.

exports.name: each_file
exports.description: Runs a closure once on each file a pool holds when the call runs, with the closure's own effect.

exports.name: prune
exports.description: Runs a closure on each file a pool holds; the closure may delete and nothing worse (confirm physical_key ceiling).
